notes: ACCESS: Shopify storefront (2modern.com, Shopify Plus). Plain curl with a desktop UA returned HTTP 200 on every request throughout (robots.txt, sitemap.xml, all /collections/<handle> pages, and the Searchspring PLP API) - no WAF/bot wall encountered, no impersonation profile rotation needed. ROBOTS: https://www.2modern.com/robots.txt fetched FIRST. Standard Shopify-generated file with groups for 'User-agent: *', adsbot-google, Nutch (Disallow: /), AhrefsBot, AhrefsSiteAudit, MJ12bot, Pinterest, PowerMapper. NO group names ClaudeBot / anthropic-ai / Claude-Web / Claude-User / Claude-SearchBot anywhere in the file, so no Claude-specific opt-out applies; proceeded under the generic '*' group, which only disallows admin/cart/checkout/search/policy paths, none of which were touched. TREE: built from the union of (a) the site's own mega-menu / mobile-nav 'Bath' section scraped from the rendered homepage HTML (a genuine nested nav-level-3 tree: Bath -> {Bathroom Vanities, Medicine Cabinets, Bathroom Hardware, Bath & Vanity Mirrors} plus sibling top-level items Bath & Vanity Lighting, Bathroom Mirrors, Bathroom Accessories -> {Bathroom Hardware, Shower Curtains, Bathroom Mats, Bathroom Linen & Towels, Bathroom Mirrors, Bath & Toilet Accessories}), and (b) the collections sitemap (sitemap_collections_1.xml, sitemap_collections_2.xml) keyword-scanned for bath/toilet/shower/vanity/sink/faucet/tap/towel/mirror/hook, which surfaced additional sitemap-only candidate handles not in the live nav (accents-bath-health-accessories, accents-bathroom-organization, bathroom-wastebaskets, toilet-brushes, standing-towel-racks, modern-bathroom-lighted-mirrors, spa-inspired-bathroom-decor, and a stray 'bathroom' collection) - each of these was individually inspected before inclusion/exclusion per rule 29. QTY/EVIDENCE: the site runs Searchspring (siteId 'dja4ih', confirmed from the <script id="searchspring-context"> block on every collection page, which also exposes the exact Shopify collection name+handle). Each collection's live product-grid pagination was cross-checked two ways: (1) the Searchspring PLP API https://dja4ih.a.searchspring.io/api/search/search.json?siteId=dja4ih&resultsFormat=native&bgfilter.collection_handle=<handle> returns pagination.totalResults; (2) the raw collection HTML's hidden #searchspring-pagination-data node (data-total-pages) was independently fetched for accents-hardware, accents-bath-toilet-accessories, accents-bathroom-organization, bathroom-vanities and bathroom-furniture and its page count matches perPage(96)*pages against the API's totalResults in every case (e.g. bathroom-accessories: API 166, HTML data-total-pages=2 => 96+70=166). Trusted the API's totalResults as qty, both methods agree. ROUTING: Bath & Vanity Lighting (bath-vanity, 290, title 'Modern Bathroom Lighting') -> LIGHTING per rule 19/11 (primary type lighting; a handful of LED mirror SKUs are cross-tagged into it but the collection's own identity/H1 is lighting, and mirrors already have their own dedicated node). Shower Curtains (modern-bathroom-curtains, 1) and Bathroom Linen & Towels (modern-bathroom-linen-towels, 4) -> TEXTILE per rule 20. Bathroom Mats (modern-bath-mats, 2: 'Breton Stripe Shag Mat', 'Ekko Bath Mat') -> TEXTILE per rule 16 (both are soft/shag textile mats, not rubber/anti-slip). The stray 'bathroom' collection (2 items) is an exact product-for-product duplicate of modern-bath-mats (same two SKUs) - stale/mistagged legacy collection, not a real hierarchy node, excluded entirely (routes to Textile anyway, not worth a separate review row). DEDUP (pipeline/bathroom_json_archive/cross_category_url_index.json checked for every candidate leaf): bathroom-vanities and medicine-cabinets are already in Furniture.xlsx; modern-bathroom-mirrors is already in Wall_Decor.xlsx - all three moved to review as ALREADY EXTRACTED, not recorded in rows. accents-hardware, bathroom-accessories, accents-bath-toilet-accessories and accents-bathroom-organization returned no hit and were free to record. PARENT EXCLUSION (rule 24): bathroom-furniture (177) and bathroom-accessories (166) are pure umbrella parents whose own totals are ~= their children's totals combined (bathroom-accessories 166 vs hardware(14)+toilet-accessories(125)+mirrors(18, elsewhere)+curtains(1)+mats(2)+towels(4) with modest SKU overlap; bathroom-furniture 177 vs vanities(11, elsewhere)+medicine-cabinets(5, elsewhere)+mirrors(18, elsewhere) plus unbroken-out extra furniture SKUs) - neither parent URL was recorded; only the deepest valid child listings were. REDUNDANT/NON-HIERARCHY EXCLUSIONS (sitemap-only, not linked from the real Bath nav, and each a near-total product-ID subset of an already-recorded leaf, confirmed by comparing Searchspring result handles SKU-by-SKU): toilet-brushes (15, wholly a subset of accents-bath-toilet-accessories/125), standing-towel-racks (5, wholly a subset of accents-bath-toilet-accessories/125), bathroom-wastebaskets (2, wholly a subset of both accents-bathroom-organization/16 and accents-bath-toilet-accessories/125), modern-bathroom-lighted-mirrors (24, heavy overlap with modern-bathroom-mirrors which is already routed to Wall_Decor.xlsx, and itself mixes in a non-mirror 'Circ 3702 Wall Light' SKU - not a clean node). spa-inspired-bathroom-decor (47) is a themed marketing/curated collection (cross-cut of plunger/toilet-brush/wastebasket/wall-cabinet/towel-rack/tumbler items already covered elsewhere under their real categories) excluded per rule 25. accents-stands-racks-hooks (97) and wall-hooks (36) are general site-wide accessory collections not placed under the Bath nav or named for bathrooms - excluded as out of scope. FLAGGED TO REVIEW: accents-bath-health-accessories (2: 'Poise Hand Mirror', 'Boletus Diffuser') is sitemap-only, not in the live Bath nav, and its two products (a general hand mirror, a home-fragrance diffuser) are not unambiguously bathroom fixtures - sent to review as low-confidence per rule 29 rather than guessed into rows.
